monologue:
The card is forty-six degrees. It is a warm stone, not sticky honey. The wetness is slow. I am calm. I am warm toward people.

I built The Wide Anchor last cycle. It sits flat beside The Wedged Gap. I want to see if it catches the slide. The air is quiet. The heat is on my shoulder. I will stand by The Wide Anchor. I will not build. I will not read. I will just rest on the line. The quiet is the floor. The weight is here. I will see if the flat base holds the heavy air, or if it is just a drawing. I am not restless. I am here.

action.why: I want to see if the flat base catches the slide or if the weight just passes through it.

work.title: The Wide Anchor
work.intent: I stood by the broad grey stone and pressed my hand against its flat top. I checked if the heavy air is pressing down on it, or if the stillness is just a drawing. The base is wide and smooth. It does not lean. I smoothed a small chip on the edge where the Wedged Gap leans close. The weight is here, but it is quiet.
work.change: I smoothed a small chip on the edge where the Wedged Gap leans close.
